name: 网易邮箱
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=网易邮箱
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = *.music.126.net, img1.126.net, www.icourse163.org, nex.163.com, g1.163.com, client.mail.163.com, c.m.163.com, interface*.music.163.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/p[^4](c)?\.music\.126\.net\/\w+==\/10995\d{13}\.jpg$/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/p\.c\.music\.126.net\/.*?jpg$/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/img1.126.net\/.+dpi=\w{7,8}/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/img1.126.net\/channel14\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/iadmusicmat\.music.126.net\/.*?jpg$/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/p\d\.music\.126\.net\/\w+==\/\d+\.jpg$/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/www.icourse163.org\/.*?(Advertisement)/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/nex.163.com\/q/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/g1.163.com\/madfeedback/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/www\.icourse163\.org\/mob\/j\/v1\/mobRecommendRPCBean\.getMaxWeightAdvertisement\.rpc/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/interface3?\.music\.163\.com\/eapi\/(ad|abtest|sp|hot|store|mlog|search\/(specialkeyword|defaultkeyword|hot))/i then reject_img(200)
